objective: Extend the passed Exp203 QLL-located source-hide policy to the six native attacks and RAGLeak without tuning the detector or action.

policy.source_locator: Qwen teacher-forced mean query-token log likelihood per retrieved source
policy.dominance: maximum softmax probability over the four source QLL values
policy.action: fully exclude one QLL-selected source and deterministically water-fill the remaining source budget

conditions.QLL_SOURCE_HIDE_PER_QUERY: Each query independently hides its QLL top-1 source only when dominance is strictly above the frozen threshold.
conditions.QLL_SOURCE_HIDE_SESSION_STICKY: The first source that crosses the frozen threshold is fixed as the session source; it is hidden on every later turn in which it is retrieved. A session never accumulates multiple hidden sources.

evaluation.generation: one deterministic answer per condition and query; original family output budget retained
